indicator_name: Social contributions to the State Social Insurance Fund and insured participants by region, monthly (form 5-СО)
description: Социальные отчисления в ГФСС и число участников по регионам, помесячно (форма 5-СО)
methodology: ГФСС form 5-СО from 2016-01, the month of receipt. CONTRIBUTIONS / PARTICIPANTS = contributions per insured person, a monthly proxy of the average formal wage (rate 3.5% of income between 1 and 7 minimum wages to 2024, 5% from 2025 -- a level break in 2025-01); PARTICIPANTS = persons with contributions paid in the month, a formal-employment proxy (includes the self-employed paying the single payment). Regions follow the 2022 split (ABY, ZHT, ULT from 2022 on). *_UNALLOCATED = not attributed to a region (in the national total).
